json_ld.description:
Wool fleece hits different. Not plastic. Unlike traditional fleece made from plastic, this hoodie is woven from luxurious all-natural wool yarn, giving you easy, wear-anywhere warmth for all your travels.

We’re proud of our new natural wool fleece hoodie that's breathable, odor-resistant, and quick-drying.

And yes, while wool does shed, it’s a natural fiber that will break down rather than contribute to the plastic pollution problem.
  • The Woolaroo Hoodie is a unisex garment.
  • Sorted, recycled, spun, and woven in Italy, our partner Manteco created a plush fabric that is made completely of recycled wool, helping to divert pre- and post-consumer virgin wool textiles from landfills and putting this valuable fiber back into circulation.
  • The color in this garment is made from combining recycled pre- and post-consumer waste, which helps to spare the use of any additional water or dyestuffs.
  • This hoodie is designed to wrap you in endless comfort and effortless style from the moment you throw it on.
  • Cozy lined hood in organic cotton and a roomy kangaroo pocket with our signature OK logo.
  • Clean finished internal seams with organic cotton binding.
